stages.effect: Exhaustion level 1, disadvantage on STR checks, and any HP regained from resting is halved.
Exhaustion level 2, regain only half HP from healing magic, and speed is halved.
Exhaustion level 3, cannot regain HP except by Greater Restoration, and disadvantage on all saving throws.
Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight. Eyes bleed faintly.
Blinded condition is applied. Blinded until the rot is cured with rare Eyebright herb or Lesser Restoration.

name: Curse of the Crawling Grave

stages.effect: Cannot regain HP. Skin turns dusty and dry like tomb rot.
Max HP is reduced by 1d10 each dawn. If Max HP drops to 0, the character dies and rises as a Ghoul.

cure: Remove Curse spell or destroying the reliquary of the mummy lord.
